title: CanonicalWard
description: Pilot canonical entity. See docs/architecture/02-canonical-data-model.md. Deliberately transport-agnostic (plain JSON Schema, not a TypeScript-only type) so a future server, ETL job, or a different ULB's non-TypeScript system can validate against the same contract this frontend's Ward interface (src/types/organisation.ts) already satisfies.

tenantId.description: The corporation this ward belongs to - see src/config/corporations.ts.

code.description: The corporation's own published ward code, e.g. 'K/W' for Brihanmumbai.
